_owner: The export filename token grammar. One grammar, two mediums; engine code and prose read this file rather than restating it.
segment_rule: Exactly two dash-separated name segments before the code block: Market, then Creative Name. There is no hook/angle segment.

market.rule: The language code uppercased (de -> DE, pt-br -> PT-BR), matching a code in languages.json.
market.localization_rule: Only the leading market token differs across a localization set. The remaining basename is inherited byte-for-byte: version number, metadata block, date, extension, and folder membership.

creative_name.rule: 2-4 words, Title Case, unique per visual concept. Spaces are fine; underscores are not.
creative_name.versioning: First version carries no suffix; later versions append ' 2', ' 3', ... to the same base name.

source.rule: Single lowercase word recording where the concept came from.

fixed.rule: TH- is reserved and unused; always literally 'TH-na'. Never invent a value.

ratio.rule: The artifact's actual aspect ratio (9x16, 1x1, 4x5, 16x9). Derived from the file, never guessed.

date.rule: Stamped on the first write and preserved afterwards. A localization inherits the source date when the campaign contract requires it.

style_rule: FB- vocabularies are per-medium and never shared: a video file never carries a statics style and vice versa. New values are lowercase, one word, descriptive, and adding one is a deliberate edit to this file.
legacy_note: No legacy author constants. If an archive of yours carries an older author token, list it here so the tool recognises those files; never hand-write a filename where tooling authors it.
